rows.en:
(Today Pinon-chan and I are going
to enjoy a classical concert!)

Still, who'd have thought you'd be
interested in classical music, \p...
I'm a little surprised.

Well, actually, Michel couldn't go because of
his part-time job, so he just gave me the tickets.

I see, so that's how it is.
I couldn't picture you listening to classical music.

What about you, Pinon-chan?
Do you listen to it?

Well, a little.
Otherwise I'd hardly have come
just because you invited me.
Guess that's true.

It's almost time for it to start.
We should head inside too.
Mm, that concert wasn't half bad.

Yeah, I thought it was a good concert too.
I couldn't tell you exactly what made it good, though...

It's music.
As long as the person listening enjoys it,
that's all that matters.
Yeah, you're right, Pinon-chan.

(Pinon-chan seemed to enjoy it too,
so maybe I'll invite her again if I get the chance.)

(Today Pinon-chan and I are going
to enjoy a classical concert!)

Well, actually, Michel-kun couldn't go because of
his part-time job, so he just gave me the tickets.
Guess that's true.
rows.notes: Female; also scd_com_618 (Christmas with Yuu), generic agreement.

rows.en:
Yeah, I thought it was a good concert too.
I couldn't tell you exactly what made it good, though...
Yeah, you're right, Pinon-chan.

(I came to see a movie with Pinon-chan,
but is this movie really a good idea...?)

Hey, Pinon-chan,
are you really okay with this horror movie?

I-I just happen to be in the mood
for a horror movie right now!

But, Pinon-chan,
you totally can't handle horror movies, right?
You don't have to push yourself like that...

Y-you just don't let up, do you?!
Come on, let's hurry up, get our tickets and go in!
Ah, wait up, Pinon-chan!
Th-that movie wasn't scary at all!
(Your legs are shaking, Pinon-chan...)

B-but you were scared,
weren't you, \p?

So, being the kind person I am...
I-I could hold your hand for you!
I-it's not like I'M the one who's scared!

Haha, you're right.
I'm way too scared, so would you
hold my hand, Pinon-chan?

Wh-what am I going to do with you...
Just for a little while, got it...

(Pinon-chan's cute when she's scared like this,
too. Maybe we should come see another
horror movie together sometime...)

(I came to see a movie with Pinon-chan,
but is this movie really a good idea...?)
(Your legs are shaking, Pinon-chan...)

Hehe, you're right.
I'm way too scared, so would you
hold my hand, Pinon-chan?

(Pinon-chan's cute when she's scared like this,
too. Maybe we should come see another
horror movie together sometime...)

(Pinon-chan called me to the lab,
but what on earth could she want?)
So you've come, \p...

Is there something you want
me to help you with, Pinon-chan?
Not Pinon-chan! Call me Pinon-sensei!
S-sorry, Pinon-sensei...

Hmmm...
Is this really such an adult thing?
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. otonappoi as 'adult' throughout this scene to keep Michel's innuendo.

rows.en:
Huh? Adult?
What do you mean, Pinon-chan?

After school...
A female teacher calls a student into an empty classroom...
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders; quoting Michel, sentence continues in c12579.

rows.en:
...is super adult,
or so Michel told me......
(What is he teaching her...? That Michel......)

But there's nothing adult about this at all!
Don't tell me Michel tricked me?!

Pinon-chan...
You can forget whatever Michel
taught you, right now.
I-is that so?

And here I thought this would finally make me
even more adult than I already am...
(She doesn't have to be that disappointed...)

(Anyway, that Michel,
teasing Pinon-chan like that...
I'd better have a word with him later.)

(Pinon-chan called me to the lab,
but what on earth could she want?)
(What is he teaching her...? Honestly, Michel-kun......)

Pinon-chan...
You can forget whatever Michel-kun
taught you, right now.

(Anyway, Michel-kun,
teasing Pinon-chan like that...
I'd better have a word with him later.)

(I feel like something similar
happened before...)
rows.notes: Player, both genders; repeat visit of frd_pnn_114.

rows.en:
Ummm, did Michel teach you something
again, by any chance, Pinon-chan?

You figured it out.
Actually, Michel taught me a surefire way
to look adult......
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders; cut off by the player.

rows.en: Forget it this instant, Pinon-chan!
Awww~~

(You're really teasing Pinon-chan
too much, Michel...)

Ummm, did Michel-kun teach you something
again, by any chance, Pinon-chan?

(You're really teasing Pinon-chan
too much, Michel-kun...)

uncertain: c12576-c12593 (frd_pnn_114): otonappoi rendered 'adult' throughout the scene (not 'grown-up' as in frd_pnn_107) so Michel's innuendo about a female teacher summoning a student after school still reads.
